name: Hornero Stopwatch
description: Stopwatch 2.0: compact bar stopwatch with a popover, wall-clock-anchored elapsed time correct across sleep/reload and an optional tenths display. Pure QML, no processes or network.
author: HorneroOS contributors

showTenths.description: Show tenths of a second in the elapsed time.

accumulatedMs.description: Saved elapsed milliseconds while paused. Managed by the stopwatch; do not edit.

startedEpochMs.description: Saved start anchor in epoch milliseconds (0 when paused). Managed by the stopwatch; do not edit.

changelog.notes: Productivity Timers 2.0: compact indicator plus popover controls, wall-clock-anchored timing persisted across sleep/reload (no per-tick drift), typed showTenths setting (default on), Theme tokens and Argentine Spanish translation.
Bar stopwatch with start, pause and reset, showing elapsed time as mm:ss.t.
